newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS SPOTLIGHT-ANALYSIS OF HINGIS V NAGYOVA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS SPOTLIGHT-ANALYSIS OF HINGIS V NAGYOVA.

text.p: Analysis of Tuesday's French Open women's singles first round match between top seed Martina Hingis of Switzerland and Slovakia's Henrieta Nagyova.
Hingis broke Nagyova in the opening game and stayed on top almost effortlessly from then on. Nagyova earned a break point in the fourth game but Hingis saved it with a forehand volley.
Nagyova could do very little after that and eventually hit a forehand wide on set point.
Nagyova won her serve to take her first game of the match and lead 1-0. But Hingis responded by winning the next game to love before breaking her opponent for a 2-1 lead.
Nagyova held her serve again in the fifth game to make it 3-2 but Hingis won the next three games. A helpless Nagyova hit a backhand wide on match point after 51 minutes of a one-sided encounter.
